id.description: p-<date>-<NNN>-<xxxx>; NNN counts that day's proposals, xxxx is 4 lowercase hex drawn at random so two clones proposing on one day do not collide. The shape before the suffix, p-<date>-<NNN>, is still accepted.

rationale.description: Why this is worth deciding. Plain text.

author.description: A member id, or the CAIP-10 id of an address no member lists (DAO-OS L5 spec §6.3), set by the server from the actor, never from the request.

classes.description: The class of every op, whole classes.

rules.description: The normalised rules it was opened under, one per distinct rule id (ruling P2-R5). Their shape is checked by lib/rules.mjs checkGovernance, through lib/proposals.mjs checkProposals.

opened_as.description: The Hats reading the proposal was opened on, for an author under a role sourced from a hat or at an address (DAO-OS L5 spec §7.2).

rev.description: First 12 hex of sha256 over the ops without bases (ruling P2-R7).

base.description: The trunk sha the branch was last replayed onto.

ops.description: The content; the branch is derived from it (ruling P2-R6).

statement.description: Optional: present means the proposal is recorded as a decision in DECISIONS.md (spec §3.9).

decision.description: The id of the decision row, when one was written.

as.description: The Hats reading the closing was made on, for a closer under a role sourced from a hat or at an address (DAO-OS L5 spec §7.2).

checked.description: A ratify's fresh reading of every actor whose act is counted (DAO-OS L5 spec §7.2, §7.4).

hat.description: The hat the actor acted under: the role's hat they wear (a hat ref).

block.description: The block the reading was made at.

wearers.description: The hat's wearers, as the tree listed them (CAIP-10); empty when the list could not be read.

complete.description: Whether that list is the whole of them: false off Celo, Ethereum and Sepolia, or when the list could not be read.

hatAct.description: What an act under a hat records (DAO-OS L5 spec §7.2): the reading it was judged on.

ref.description: The private store's `pending` row that holds the real ops.

class.description: The class the ops are judged under: their registry's, or a private collection's.

digest.description: SHA-256 over a random salt and the canonical JSON of the real ops, both kept in the private store.

privateOp.description: An op on private data, held in git only as a placeholder (DAO-OS L5 spec §9.6): no record, no value.

base.description: SHA-256 of the entry's canonical YAML when staged; null for a create.

by.description: A member id, the CAIP-10 id of an address no member lists (DAO-OS L5 spec §6.3), or system:<system id> for a system event.

base.description: replay: the trunk sha the branch was rebuilt on.

outcome.description: system: what the outside system reported.

required.description: system: signatures the outside system needs.

executed.description: system: executed on chain, and whether it succeeded is not known yet; the outcome stays pending (DAO-OS L7 spec §11.1).

chains.description: system: each chain's own reading of an attach that spans several chains, beside the aggregate (DAO-OS L7 spec §11.2).

decision.description: A closing event: the decision row id.

as.description: The Hats reading the event was judged on, for an actor under a role sourced from a hat or at an address (DAO-OS L5 spec §7.2).

$comment: data/proposals.yaml (P2 spec §3.1, §3.2). Written only by the proposal routes (the registry is a ledger). The rules snapshot is checked by checkGovernance and the cross-field checks by lib/proposals.mjs checkProposals, which validateRepo runs.
